sampling.stratification: source run x method/penalty x requested length band x seed family; ceil(10%) in each nonempty stratum; SHA256 fixed-seed ranking

rubric.grammar: 0=unusable word salad;1=some locally recognizable English but severe sentence-level errors;2=mixed/awkward but partly grammatical;3=mostly grammatical;4=fluent/correct
rubric.coherence: 0=no apparent proposition or relations;1=loose fragments with weak local links;2=some relation but not unified;3=unified short prose;4=strongly unified paragraph
rubric.repetition_variety: 0=extremely repetitive;1=distracting repetition;2=noticeable repetition/limited variety;3=some variety with modest repetition;4=varied with little distracting repetition; higher is better

blinding_and_quality_caveat: Method/aggregate metadata visible. No prior item-level natural-language scores read. Coordinator accidentally saw first item exact=true, letters=48, recorded_grammar_complete=null, recorded_accepted=true and strict-check heading. Item1 independent reviewer received text and non-judgment metadata only. No human ratings or inter-rater reliability claim.
overall_finding: 42/42 sampled occurrences exact; no grammatical sentence or cohesive paragraph. Slight variety differences do not establish a quality winner. Exactness alone does not meet the long readable prose goal.
